fields.description: A short, permanent label for this mapping, e.g. "Settlement Reconciliation". Shown in the Sync Log filter and everywhere this mapping is referenced -- avoid renaming once syncs have run against it.
fields.label: Mapping Name

fields.description: Unchecked mappings are skipped entirely by both sync directions and the scheduler.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The Alaiy OS doctype this mapping syncs -- any doctype works, sync logic has no hardcoded target.
fields.label: Doctype

fields.description: The doctype field that uniquely identifies a record across syncs. "name" (the doctype's own primary key) is correct for almost every doctype.
fields.label: Unique ID Field

fields.description: A Sheet column LETTER (e.g. "B"), not a header name -- holds the Unique ID Field's value, kept separate from Fields below since the id is a matching key for the sync itself, not necessarily something meant to be user-visible/editable data. Pull sync (Sheets -> Alaiy OS) uses it to find which record a row belongs to.
fields.label: ID Column

fields.description: Paste either the full Sheet URL or just its ID -- if you paste the URL, the ID is extracted automatically on save. The connected Google account (see Google Sheets Connector Settings) must have edit access to it.
fields.label: Spreadsheet ID

fields.description: The TAB NAME shown at the bottom of the spreadsheet (not a column letter), e.g. "Sheet1". Case-sensitive, must match exactly.
fields.label: Sheet Tab

fields.description: Which row in the tab holds column headers. Data starts on the row after this one.
fields.label: Header Row

fields.description: Which doctype fields are exposed to this Sheet, and which column each one maps to. Only fields listed here are ever read from or written to the Sheet -- everything else on the doctype stays invisible to Sheet users (P0 acceptance: admin chooses exactly which fields are exposed).
fields.label: Fields
